Heard Mr. F Haque, learned Counsel for the accused petitioners as well as Mr. B Sharma, Page No.# 2/3 learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State respondent.

By this petition filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused petitioners, namely, 1. Md. Mannan Miya @ Manna Miya and 2. Md. Habijul Ali have prayed for granting bail, in connection with Biswanath Chariali P.S. Case No. 38/2023 u/s 420/379/411/34 of the IPC r/w 13 of the Assam Cattle Preservation (Amendment) Act r/w Section 11 of Prevention of Cruelty to Animal Act.

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to Animal Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case diary, as called for, is placed before this Court.

The FIR reveals the allegation that during Naka checking, the informant intercepted a truck and recovered 24 numbers of cattle from the present accused petitioners and they failed to produce any documents.
It is noticed that the accused petitioners are in judicial custody for 30 days since 21.03.2023.
A perusal of the case diary reveals prima facie incriminating material against the accused petitioners' complicity in the commission of alleged offences.
The investigation appears to have substantially progressed.

However, considering the length of detention and in the backdrop of facts and circumstances, this Court is of the opinion that further continuation of the accused petitioners in the interest of investigation is not warranted.

Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioners, named above shall be released on furnishing bail of Rs. 40,000/- (Forty Thousand) each with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Biswanath Chariali subject to the following conditions- :
(i) That the accused petitioners shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer as and when required;
(ii) That the accused petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court; and (iii) That the accused petitioners shall refrain from committing any similar offences Page No.# 3/3 in future, of which they are accused or suspected of commission.
This disposes of the bail application.
